text_block_list.name: Magazine Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That racing racewear really is 
wonderful! The cool, icy design suits you 
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that so...
choice_data_list: Ice, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her calmly handle the magazine 
shoot, I remembered the time we finalized 
the design for her racing outfit.
choice_data_list: Ice, huh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: A racewear design request form, is it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will organize the policy and requests
by 
myself. ...If you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She walked away without changing her 
expression in the slightest. She's so 
capable that I shouldn't need to worry, 
but still—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward,
when I headed to the library to 
look something up—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ... Thanks.
choice_data_list: Are you doing some research too?
Are you here to do some research too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Glancing at her desk,
I saw piles of books 
on color theory, design,
and various other 
subjects.
choice_data_list: Doing some research too?
Doing some research too?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That is correct.
choice_data_list: Ah, you were brainstorming design ...
Yeah, I was brainstorming design i...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly—
among the books she had gathered, 
one in particular caught my eye.
choice_data_list: The Snow Queen... Do you like this...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: The Snow Queen... Do you like this...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
A tale of bonds, you say...? As if anyone 
would care.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (I don't like stories. But—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(When I first read 'The Snow Queen'... I 
thought it was wonderful.)

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text: A castle... of ice...

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text:
A cold, freezing, lonely place. No one 
touches me... no one comes.

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text: ...All alone, this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text: ... Ice... must be nice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...An impenetrable fortress that lets no 
one approach. One that will never, ever 
melt—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ice...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You're right. This is all I have.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Here. This is my design request form 
for the racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Written there was something beautiful,
yet 
tinged with a certain loneliness—
choice_data_list: Ice that won't melt...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: Ice that never melts...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her way of being—rejecting others and 
remaining aloof— I felt as though I was 
witnessing it anew.
choice_data_list: Just a hunch, but something like that?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Um...
Is there something wrong with what's 
written here?
choice_data_list: (Still... I won't let her fight al...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Met with a suspicious glare, I hastily 
shook my head.
choice_data_list: Could it be... you like ice motifs?
I understand what direction you wa...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Why?
choice_data_list: Could it be... you like ice motifs?
I understand the direction you wan...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: …………Not really.
choice_data_list: The Snow Queen had an ice castle, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Can I go back now?
choice_data_list: (...At the very least, she doesn't...
(...At the very least, she doesn't...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"How about incorporating jewel 
embellishments reminiscent of ice shards 
into your racewear design?" —I suggest to 
her.
choice_data_list: Wait! That ice castle gave me an i...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Suit yourself. After all, it's the 
designer who decides what gets used."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later—I saw her gazing at the 
jewels adorning her racing outfit. Seeing 
that she didn't seem displeased with them 
made me happy, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It seems there are no problems, then.
choice_data_list: I think it'll turn out to be a bea...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
choice_data_list: I think it'll make a gorgeous raci...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She walks away as if her business is
done. 
Her figure is truly—
choice_data_list: Ice, huh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Unwavering, unyielding, and forever 
stronger than anyone else.
choice_data_list: Ice, huh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —From now on too, forever.
